items.control_name: Disable Blob Public Access on All Storage Accounts
items.description: Storage accounts must have 'allowBlobPublicAccess' set to false to prevent anonymous read access.
items.current_value: 12 accounts have allowBlobPublicAccess = false; 1 account set to true

items.control_name: Enforce Soft-Delete and Purge Protection on Azure Key Vaults
items.description: Key Vaults must have both soft-delete (90 days retention) and purge protection enabled.
items.current_value: Soft-delete enabled on 100% of vaults; Purge Protection disabled on 'kv-dev-keys'
items.remediation_notes: Enable purge protection on 'kv-dev-keys' to protect against malicious key deletion.

items.control_name: Enforce Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) with Customer Managed Keys on Azure SQL
items.description: Azure SQL databases must use TDE with Customer Managed Keys (CMK) stored in Azure Key Vault.
items.recommended_value: TDE enabled with Key Vault Customer-Managed Key (CMK)
items.remediation_notes: Evaluate requirement for Customer Managed Key TDE versus platform default encryption.

items.control_name: Enforce Minimum TLS Version 1.2 on All Storage Accounts
items.description: Storage account connections must enforce minimumTlsVersion = 'TLS1_2'.
items.remediation_notes: Verify client compatibility with TLS 1.3 as it becomes available.
